tier_reason: Tier stays C. Caveat correction: the 5.0x over DART (flag 1) is a crippled baseline (DART 4.3.4 with angular-momentum bug dart#424 and a Gazebo collision checker without broadphase); the cleaner figure is 3.0x at flag 0, and ODE is faster than Bullet in most rows, so Bullet is not the fastest engine in its own benchmark.

corrections.claimed_speedup: Gazebo-classic boxes benchmark: Bullet about 3.0x faster than DART 4.3.4 with collisions off (flag 0); the 5.0x flag-1 figure rests on DART's missing broadphase and bug dart#424; Bullet is slower than ODE in 10 of 12 rows and only 1.04x faster at 81 boxes.
corrections.caveats: Boxes never touch (spawned 1.8 m apart with identical velocities); one run per row; Gazebo per-step overhead about 64 us dominates; Linux builds have no SSE by default; maintenance mode since 2024-04.

tier_reason: Lowered C to D: the cuBLAS baseline curves cannot be reproduced from the repo (the harness only drives clBLAS), the comparison is across different GPUs whose peak rates explain the double-precision gaps, and the project is abandoned since 2017; directional only.

corrections.caveats: S9150 vs K40 cross-GPU charts; DGEMM/ZGEMM gaps track DP peaks (2530 vs 1660 GFLOPS); DTRSM 47% of peak vs cuBLAS 73%; AutoGemm tables Hawaii/Fiji only; CMake defaults to Debug; CLBlast (wave 8, B) beats it.

tier_reason: Tier stays C. Caveat correction: scs-python 3.3.1 links libmkl_sequential.a, so the SCS CPU rows are single-threaded like the other CPU solvers (the record's '4-thread MKL Pardiso' is wrong); the GPU row comes from an unpinned scs-python HEAD build, not PyPI 3.3.1.

corrections.caveats: First-party campaign by the SCS author; CPU SKU masked (EPYC Milan); prebuilt wheels, no flags; GPU rows pit an A100 against 4-core CPU runs; GPU build unpinned (git clone --depth 1); SCS CPU single-threaded (libmkl_sequential); QTQP omitted (192 s vs SCS GPU 208 s); SCS level with Clarabel on the largest QPs, behind HiGHS, Clarabel and PIQP on full LP/QP sets, last on SDPs.

tier_reason: Tier stays C. Caveat correction: the v3.1.1 baseline was built with AVX2 off (v3.1.1 default CMake) while v3.2 ran AVX2, so the headline 2.04x/2.19x is an ISA mismatch; ISA-matched figures are 1.83x/2.03x (derived from the repo's own v3.1-era 7950X CSVs).

corrections.claimed_speedup: v3.2 vs v3.1.1 self-comparison: 1.83x/2.03x ISA-matched (derived), 2.04x/2.19x as published with v3.1.1's AVX2 path disabled; no other engine compared.
corrections.caveats: Unpublished v3.1.1 scene port (7 of 14 scenes at the tag, spinner 1400 vs 500 steps); benchmark/main.c never sets b2WorldDef::capacity so the 'with capacity' row is not reproducible; v3.2 unreleased at measurement.

tier_reason: Tier stays C. corrections.caveats: Box2D 2.4.1 Step has 10 gettimeofday calls per step (empty world 74 vs 404 ns); Box2D build type undocumented (CMake default unoptimized) vs PlayRho Release -O3; TilesRest times build plus settling; issue #477 commit 8082f1c made AddPairStressTest steps 16-20 11-38x slower, PlayRho 1.6x slower at step 0; measured code is unreleased master, not v1.1.2; stale since 2024-04-30.

tier_reason: Tier stays C. corrections.baseline: PyTorch 1.5.1 eager fp32 (GPT-2 rows) and TorchScript fp32 at batch 1 (BERT rows); PyTorch fp16 never measured
corrections.caveats: No GPU sync in either timing loop (ORT 1.4.0 run_with_iobinding, timeit for TorchScript); TorchScript row flat 7.92-9.56 ms across sequence lengths (host-dispatch bound); unpublished TorchScript fp16 and batch-4 rows; v1.4.0 model list does not match the table; telemetry on by default in official builds.

tier_reason: Tier stays A (public harness, compiler, flags, GPU). Caveat correction: the 1.61x is a memory-traffic reduction on a bandwidth-starved GB10 (baseline about 281 GB/s against a 273 GB/s spec; fused kernel about 151 GB/s, derived from page data), not a faster FFT, and HBM GPUs are unmeasured.

corrections.caveats: Gain is cuFFTDx fusion cutting traffic from about 50 MB to about 16.8 MB per call on GB10 (LPDDR5x 273 GB/s); plain cudaExecutor 3% slower than cuFFT; validation loose (2e-3 relative in dB domain); JIT compile time omitted; Black-Scholes rows uncompared for correctness; make_tensor defaults to managed memory; FFT plan-cache thread bug #1039 fixed by #1040.
